headline_pain: Paying Too Much Tax on Your Biz?
primary_text: "I heard you get better tax deductions buying new." Here's what other Truganina warehouse buyers discovered at tax time: brand-new commercial property unlocks the maximum depreciation allowance under Australian tax law. The building, the slab, the cladding, roller doors, electrical, plumbing — it's all depreciable. One buyer told us his depreciation schedule added over $20,000 in deductions in year one alone. You can't get that buying a 1990s shed in Sunshine. Off-the-plan means brand new. Brand new means full deductions. These Truganina warehouses are built for owner-occupiers who want every tax advantage available. Ask us for the depreciation estimate.
description: One buyer claimed over $20,000 in depreciation deductions in year one
